author: More Perfect Union
description:
Mississippi residents are fighting Elon Musk and his polluting AI company.

xAI is burning dozens of turbines in Southaven, polluting the area and harming neighborhoods.

But residents are packing hearings, organizing, and pushing back.

Producer: Sam Black
Editor: Joseph Howard
Videographer: Josh Beckemeyer
Sound: Matthew Wefel
title: Elon Musk is poisoning ANOTHER city. “It’s torture to be outside.”
